name: Skill Swap
effect: The user swaps special abilities with the target. Use and target trade abilities.

name: Skull Bash
effect: Tucks in the head, then attacks on the next turn. Raises user's DEFENSE one stage and attacks next turn.

name: Sky Attack
effect: Searches out weak spots, then strikes the next turn. May cause opponent to flinch.

name: Sky Uppercut
effect: An uppercut thrown as if leaping into the sky. Hits even if opponent is using FLY.

name: Slack Off
effect: Slacks off and restores half the maximum HP. User recovers half the maximum HP.

name: Slam
effect: Slams the foe with a long tail, vine, etc.

name: Slash
effect: Slashes with claws, etc. Has a high critical-hit ratio. Has high critical hit ratio.

name: Sleep Powder
effect: Scatters a powder that may cause the foe to sleep. Induces sleep.

name: Sleep Talk
effect: Uses an own move randomly while asleep. Uses an own random move while asleep.

name: Sludge
effect: Sludge is hurled to inflict damage. May also poison. May induce poison.

name: Sludge Bomb
effect: Sludge is hurled to inflict damage. May also poison. May induce poison.

name: Smelling Salts
effect: Powerful against paralyzed foes, but also heals them. Stronger against a paralyzed opponent but also heals them.

name: Smog
effect: An exhaust-gas attack that may also poison. May induce poison.

name: Smokescreen
effect: Lowers the foe's accuracy using smoke, ink, etc. Lowers opponent's ACCURACY one stage.

name: Snatch
effect: Steals the effects of the move the foe uses next. Steals the effects of opponent's next move.

name: Snore
effect: A loud attack that can be used only while asleep. Can only be used while asleep.

name: Soft-Boiled
effect: Recovers up to half the user's maximum HP. User recovers half the maximum HP. Can also be used in the field.

name: Solar Beam
effect: Absorbs light in one turn, then attacks next turn. Wait for a turn and attacks the next.

name: Sonic Boom
effect: Launches shock waves that always inflict 20 HP damage. Inflicts 20 HP damage.

name: Spark
effect: An electrified tackle that may paralyze the foe. May induce paralysis.

name: Spider Web
effect: Ensnares the foe to stop it from fleeing or switching. Prevents the opponent from escaping.

name: Spike Cannon
effect: Launches sharp spikes that strike 2 to 5 times. Attacks 2-5 times in a row.

name: Spikes
effect: Sets spikes that hurt a foe switching out. Sets spikes that hurt the opponent upon switching.

name: Spit Up
effect: Releases stockpiled power (the more the better). Releases power from STOCKPILE.

name: Spite
effect: Spitefully cuts the PP of the foe's last move. Opponent's last move loses 2-5 HP.

name: Splash
effect: It's just a splash... Has no effect whatsoever.

name: Spore
effect: Scatters a cloud of spores that always induce sleep. Induces sleep.

name: Steel Wing
effect: Strikes the foe with hard wings spread wide. May raise user's DEFENSE one stage.

name: Stockpile
effect: Charges up power for up to 3 turns. User stockpiles power for up to 3 turns.

name: Stomp
effect: Stomps the enemy with a big foot. May cause flinching. May cause opponent to flinch.

name: Strength
effect: Builds enormous power, then slams the foe.

name: String Shot
effect: Binds the foe with string to reduce its SPEED. Lowers opponent's SPEED one stage.

name: Struggle
effect: Used only if all PP are gone. Also hurts the user a little. User takes recoil damage.

name: Stun Spore
effect: Scatters a powder that may paralyze the foe. Induces paralysis

name: Submission
effect: A reckless body slam that also hurts the user. User takes recoil damage.

name: Substitute
effect: Creates a decoy using 1/4 of the user's maximum HP. Creates a decoy using 1/4 of the user's maximum HP.

name: Sunny Day
effect: Boosts the power of FIRE- type moves for 5 turns. Causes Sunshine for 5 rounds.

name: Super Fang
effect: Attacks with sharp fangs and cuts half the foe's HP. Cuts half opponent's HP.

name: Superpower
effect: Boosts strength sharply, but lowers abilities. Lowers user's ATTACK and DEFENSE one stage.

name: Supersonic
effect: Emits bizarre sound waves that may confuse the foe. May induce CONFUSION.

name: Surf
effect: Creates a huge wave, then crashes it down on the foe.

name: Swagger
effect: Confuses the foe, but also sharply raises ATTACK. Induces CONFUSE. Raises opponent's ATTACK two stages.

name: Swallow
effect: Absorbs stockpiled power and restores HP. Absorbs power from STOCKPILE and recovers HP.

name: Sweet Kiss
effect: Demands a kiss with a cute look. May cause confusion. May induce CONFUSION.

name: Sweet Scent
effect: Allures the foe to reduce evasiveness. Lowers opponent's EVASIVENESS one stage.

name: Swift
effect: Sprays star-shaped rays that never miss. Cannot miss.

name: Swords Dance
effect: A fighting dance that sharply raises ATTACK. Raises user's ATTACK two stages.

name: Synthesis
effect: Restores HP. The amount varies with the weather. User restores HP.

name: Tackle
effect: Charges the foe with a full-body tackle.

name: Tail Glow
effect: Flashes a light that sharply raises SP. ATK. Raises user's SP. ATK two stages.

name: Tail Whip
effect: Wags the tail to lower the foe's DEFENSE. Lowers opponent's DEFENSE one stage.

name: Take Down
effect: A reckless charge attack that also hurts the user. User takes recoil damage.

name: Taunt
effect: Taunts the foe into only using attack moves. Opponent can only use attack moves.

name: Teeter Dance
effect: Confuses all POKéMON on the scene. Confuses all Pokémon on the field.

name: Teleport
effect: A psychic move for fleeing from battle instantly. Ends battle. Switches user in trainer battles.

name: Thief
effect: While attacking, it may steal the foe's held item. May steal opponent's item (temporarily in trainer battles).

name: Thrash
effect: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns that confuses the user. User uses the same attack for 2-3 turns then becomes confused.

name: Thunder
effect: A lightning attack that may cause paralysis. May induce paralysis.

name: Thunder Punch
effect: An electrified punch that may paralyze the foe. May induce paralysis.

name: Thunder Shock
effect: An electrical attack that may paralyze the foe. May induce paralysis.

name: Thunder Wave
effect: A weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the foe. Induces paralysis

name: Thunderbolt
effect: A strong electrical attack that may paralyze the foe. May induce paralysis.

name: Tickle
effect: Makes the foe laugh to lower ATTACK and DEFENSE. Worsens the condition of those that made appeals.

name: Torment
effect: Torments the foe and stops successive use of a move. Opponent cannot use the same move in a row.

name: Toxic
effect: Poisons the foe with an intensifying toxin. Induces severe poison.

name: Transform
effect: Alters the user's cells to become a copy of the foe. User transforms to the opponent.

name: Tri Attack
effect: Fires three types of beams at the same time. May induce burn, freeze or paralysis.

name: Trick
effect: Tricks the foe into trading held items. User trades items with opponent.

name: Triple Kick
effect: Kicks the foe 3 times in a row with rising intensity. Attacks 1-3 times in a row.

name: Twineedle
effect: Stingers on the forelegs jab the foe twice. Attacks twice. May induce poison.

name: Twister
effect: Whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe. May cause opponent to flinch. Damage is doubled if opponent is using FLY.

name: Uproar
effect: Causes an uproar for 2 to 5 turns and prevents sleep. User cannot sleep for 2-5 turns.

name: Vine Whip
effect: Strikes the foe with slender, whiplike vines.

name: Vise Grip
effect: Grips the foe with large and powerful pincers.

name: Vital Throw
effect: Makes the user's move last, but it never misses. Cannot miss. Goes last.

name: Water Gun
effect: Squirts water to attack the foe.

name: Water Pulse
effect: Attacks with ultrasonic waves. May confuse the foe May induce CONFUSION.

name: Water Sport
effect: The user becomes soaked to raise resistance to fire. Lowers the power of FIRE moves.

name: Water Spout
effect: Inflicts more damage if the user's HP is high. Inflicts more damage when the user's HP is high.

name: Waterfall
effect: Charges the foe with speed to climb waterfalls.

name: Weather Ball
effect: The move's type and power change with the weather. Depends on the weather.

name: Whirlpool
effect: Traps and hurts the foe in a whirlpool for 2 to 5 turns. Traps opponent.

name: Whirlwind
effect: Blows away the foe with wind and ends the battle. Ends battle. Switches the opponent Pokémon in a trainer battle.

name: Will-O-Wisp
effect: Inflicts a burn on the foe with intense fire. Induces burn.

name: Wing Attack
effect: Strikes the foe with wings spread wide.

name: Wish
effect: A wish that restores HP. It takes time to work. Recovers HP. Delays 1 turn.

name: Withdraw
effect: Withdraws the body into its hard shell to raise DEFENSE. Raises user's DEFENSE one stage.

name: Wrap
effect: Wraps and squeezes the foe 2 to 5 times with vines, etc. Traps opponent.

name: Yawn
effect: Lulls the foe into yawning, then sleeping next turn. User and opponent sleep the next turn.

name: Zap Cannon
effect: Powerful and sure to cause paralysis, but inaccurate. May induce paralysis.
